rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for the result or outcome of an event or process.

example.english: The outcome of this project is quite good.
example.traditional: 今次個計劃嘅結果幾理想。
example.jyutping: gam1 ci3 go3 gai3 waak6 ge3 git3 gwo2 gei2 lei5 soeng2

rows.note: Use this when the outcome is specifically a consequence, usually an unpleasant or harmful one.

example.english: Taking medicine recklessly can have a very serious outcome.
example.traditional: 亂咁食藥，後果可以好嚴重。
example.jyutping: lyun6 gam3 sik6 joek6 hau6 gwo2 ho2 ji5 hou2 jim4 zung6

rows.note: Use this for a positive result or achievement produced by work or an effort.

example.english: After working on it for so long, we can finally see the outcome.
example.traditional: 大家做咗咁耐，終於見到成果喇。
example.jyutping: daai6 gaa1 zou6 zo2 gam3 noi6 zung1 jyu1 gin3 dou2 sing4 gwo2 laa3
